tagline: An S&P 500 company that operates as a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust specializing in West Coast apartment communities
hero_kpi_rationale: Measures organic performance of the stabilized real estate portfolio, reflecting rental growth on properties held for at least one year, excluding the impact of acquisitions and dispositions.

kpis.name: Same-Property Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in rental income from properties held for at least one year, measuring organic performance.
kpis.description: Same-property revenue increased by 3.3% in 2025 compared to 2024, driven by higher average rental rates.
kpis.signal: Stable rental growth on stabilized portfolio

kpis.name: Financial Occupancy
kpis.explanation: Percentage of actual rental income relative to total potential rental income, including vacant units valued at market rent.
kpis.description: Financial occupancy remained stable at 96.2% in both 2025 and 2024, indicating strong performance in valuing vacant units.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate, despite rental market competition

kpis.name: Total Operating Communities
kpis.explanation: Total number of residential communities in operation within the company's portfolio.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, the company owned or had interests in 259 operating communities.
kpis.signal: Significant residential portfolio on the West Coast

kpis.name: Total Apartment Homes
kpis.explanation: Total number of apartment units within operating communities owned or controlled by the company.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, the portfolio included 63,077 apartment homes, excluding pre-development investments and co-investments.
kpis.signal: Portfolio of 63,000+ units concentrated on the West Coast

kpis.name: Average Rental Rate
kpis.explanation: Average rent per unit in the same-property portfolio.
kpis.description: Average rental rate increased from $2,638 in 2024 to $2,699 in 2025, a 2.3% increase.

kpis.name: Non-Same Property Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from recently acquired, developed, or consolidated properties, not included in same-property analysis.
kpis.description: Non-same property revenue increased by 35.2% in 2025, driven by several acquisitions and consolidations.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $1.887 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.39 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2018).

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $5.16 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.654 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Percentage of net income distributed as dividends: 97.7% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Same-Property Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in rental income from properties held for at least one year, measuring organic performance.
kpis.description: Same-property revenue increased by 3.3% in 2025 compared to 2024, driven by higher average rental rates.
kpis.signal: Stable rental growth on stabilized portfolio

kpis.name: Financial Occupancy
kpis.explanation: Percentage of actual rental income relative to total potential rental income, including vacant units valued at market rent.
kpis.description: Financial occupancy remained stable at 96.2% in both 2025 and 2024, indicating strong performance in valuing vacant units.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate, despite rental market competition

risks.title: High Debt
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant debt, with short- and medium-term repayment obligations, which could impact its ability to meet financial commitments.

risks.title: Market Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, with risks of declining rents and housing demand.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, particularly in housing and real estate development, which could impact its operations.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces credit risks related to its loans and borrowings, which could affect its ability to repay debt.

risks.title: Liquidity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces liquidity risks related to its cash flows and ability to meet short-term financial obligations.

risks.title: Development Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks related to its development projects, including delays, cost overruns, and failure to achieve targets.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks related to its reputation, including loss of customer and investor confidence.

ai_positioning.summary: ESS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
